name: InventorySort
title: Inventory Sort
author: Vatroslav
description:
Keeps your inventory sorted: items are grouped by type in the order of the inventory tabs, and the most valuable items come first within each type.

The mod reorders the game's own item list, not only the view, so using, equipping and dropping still act on the item you see.

Turn it off in Settings > Game > Inventory Sort.
